meta.title: Demolition
meta.description: What will you discard to protect those who are important to you?

units.rawText: The Rossum Sector, at the Admin Center.
units.displayText: The Rossum Sector, at the Admin Center.

spans.text: The Rossum Sector, at the Admin Center.

units.rawText: Liquid Entropy has dyed the outer walls purple and the entire building is shaking from Entropic bombardment. Meanwhile, hordes of Entropics pour endlessly into the structure.
units.displayText: Liquid Entropy has dyed the outer walls purple and the entire building is shaking from Entropic bombardment. Meanwhile, hordes of Entropics pour endlessly into the structure.

spans.text: Liquid Entropy has dyed the outer walls purple and the entire building is shaking from Entropic bombardment. Meanwhile, hordes of Entropics pour endlessly into the structure.

units.rawText: Go now! I can't hold on for long, Sol!
units.displayText: Go now! I can't hold on for long, Sol!

spans.text: Go now! I can't hold on for long, Sol!

units.rawText: Everyone from Rossum, this way! Vanguard team, help me hold off the incoming Entropics!
units.displayText: Everyone from Rossum, this way! Vanguard team, help me hold off the incoming Entropics!

spans.text: Everyone from Rossum, this way! Vanguard team, help me hold off the incoming Entropics!

units.rawText: Don't overextend yourselves! There's a temporary shelter up ahead. I'll have the agents show you the way!
units.displayText: Don't overextend yourselves! There's a temporary shelter up ahead. I'll have the agents show you the way!

spans.text: Don't overextend yourselves! There's a temporary shelter up ahead. I'll have the agents show you the way!

units.rawText: You're not going with us?
units.displayText: You're not going with us?

spans.text: You're not going with us?

units.rawText: Most of the researchers are gone... But I didn't see Turing!
units.displayText: Most of the researchers are gone... But I didn't see Turing!

spans.text: Most of the researchers are gone... But I didn't see Turing!

units.rawText: I'll go look for her!
units.displayText: I'll go look for her!

spans.text: I'll go look for her!

units.rawText: She went to the second floor to decompress the operands, right? Could she be trapped by fallen debris?
units.displayText: She went to the second floor to decompress the operands, right? Could she be trapped by fallen debris?

spans.text: She went to the second floor to decompress the operands, right? Could she be trapped by fallen debris?

units.rawText: Croque, take charge of the team! I'm going back to take a look!
units.displayText: Croque, take charge of the team! I'm going back to take a look!

spans.text: Croque, take charge of the team! I'm going back to take a look!

units.rawText: Got it. Now go!
units.displayText: Got it. Now go!

spans.text: Got it. Now go!

units.rawText: Sol runs back into the Admin Center without hesitation. Hannah follows close behind her, but Croque stops her.
units.displayText: Sol runs back into the Admin Center without hesitation. Hannah follows close behind her, but Croque stops her.

spans.text: Sol runs back into the Admin Center without hesitation. Hannah follows close behind her, but Croque stops her.

units.rawText: Come with me, Hannah!
units.displayText: Come with me, Hannah!

spans.text: Come with me, Hannah!

units.rawText: No! I know the layout of the place; I'll go search for Turing too!
units.displayText: No! I know the layout of the place; I'll go search for Turing too!

spans.text: No! I know the layout of the place; I'll go search for Turing too!

units.rawText: The place is a mess from all the bombardment. You should let Sol look for her! She knows the room's rough location!
units.displayText: The place is a mess from all the bombardment. You should let Sol look for her! She knows the room's rough location!

spans.text: The place is a mess from all the bombardment. You should let Sol look for her! She knows the room's rough location!

units.rawText: But that's way too inefficient! What if something happens to Turing!?
units.displayText: But that's way too inefficient! What if something happens to Turing!?

spans.text: But that's way too inefficient! What if something happens to Turing!?

units.rawText: Can you move fallen debris aside? Can you fight the Entropics?
units.displayText: Can you move fallen debris aside? Can you fight the Entropics?

spans.text: Can you move fallen debris aside? Can you fight the Entropics?

units.rawText: No! I can't! But I need to find Turing—
units.displayText: No! I can't! But I need to find Turing—

spans.text: No! I can't! But I need to find Turing—

units.rawText: Enough messing around! How will you find her? Or are you saying you don't trust Sol? She's a professional search-and-rescue responder, you know!
units.displayText: Enough messing around! How will you find her? Or are you saying you don't trust Sol? She's a professional search-and-rescue responder, you know!

spans.text: Enough messing around! How will you find her? Or are you saying you don't trust Sol? She's a professional search-and-rescue responder, you know!

units.rawText: It's not that I don't trust her, but... I can't... Not again...
units.displayText: It's not that I don't trust her, but... I can't... Not again...

spans.text: It's not that I don't trust her, but... I can't... Not again...

units.rawText: You'd only lower her work efficiency if you went in right now. Have faith in Sol; she'll bring Turing back. She did it before, didn't she?
units.displayText: You'd only lower her work efficiency if you went in right now. Have faith in Sol; she'll bring Turing back. She did it before, didn't she?

spans.text: You'd only lower her work efficiency if you went in right now. Have faith in Sol; she'll bring Turing back. She did it before, didn't she?

units.rawText: As for you, you also have things you need to do. Help me deal with the Entropics and create a safe zone for them.
units.displayText: As for you, you also have things you need to do. Help me deal with the Entropics and create a safe zone for them.

spans.text: As for you, you also have things you need to do. Help me deal with the Entropics and create a safe zone for them.

units.rawText: ...Please, Sol, you have to rescue Turing...
units.displayText: ...Please, Sol, you have to rescue Turing...

spans.text: ...Please, Sol, you have to rescue Turing...

units.rawText: There is a sniffle in Hannah's voice, a stark contrast from the youthful way in which she usually speaks. She clenches her fists tightly.
units.displayText: There is a sniffle in Hannah's voice, a stark contrast from the youthful way in which she usually speaks. She clenches her fists tightly.

spans.text: There is a sniffle in Hannah's voice, a stark contrast from the youthful way in which she usually speaks. She clenches her fists tightly.

units.rawText: I'll help you compute the positions for the Entropics attacking from long range so you can help get everyone away!
units.displayText: I'll help you compute the positions for the Entropics attacking from long range so you can help get everyone away!

spans.text: I'll help you compute the positions for the Entropics attacking from long range so you can help get everyone away!

units.rawText: That's more like it. Let's go!
units.displayText: That's more like it. Let's go!

spans.text: That's more like it. Let's go!

units.rawText: Inside the Admin Center.
units.displayText: Inside the Admin Center.

spans.text: Inside the Admin Center.

units.rawText: Damn, but this place is dark and there's Liquid Entropy everywhere...
units.displayText: Damn, but this place is dark and there's Liquid Entropy everywhere...

spans.text: Damn, but this place is dark and there's Liquid Entropy everywhere...

units.rawText: Urgh, now's not the time to be scared, <size=40>Turing? Turing! Where are you?</size>
units.displayText: Urgh, now's not the time to be scared, Turing? Turing! Where are you?

spans.text: Urgh, now's not the time to be scared,
Turing? Turing! Where are you?

units.rawText: Hiss!
units.displayText: Hiss!

spans.text: Hiss!

units.rawText: With a flash of steel, the halves of the Entropic creature twitch feebly on the ground before going still in a puddle of Liquid Entropy.
units.displayText: With a flash of steel, the halves of the Entropic creature twitch feebly on the ground before going still in a puddle of Liquid Entropy.

spans.text: With a flash of steel, the halves of the Entropic creature twitch feebly on the ground before going still in a puddle of Liquid Entropy.

units.rawText: You guys might be a bit threatening in hordes, but if you send your mooks at me individually, I'll cut you all to pieces.
units.displayText: You guys might be a bit threatening in hordes, but if you send your mooks at me individually, I'll cut you all to pieces.

spans.text: You guys might be a bit threatening in hordes, but if you send your mooks at me individually, I'll cut you all to pieces.

units.rawText: Sol steps over the bits of the slowly-disappearing Entropic and keeps calling Turing's name.
units.displayText: Sol steps over the bits of the slowly-disappearing Entropic and keeps calling Turing's name.

spans.text: Sol steps over the bits of the slowly-disappearing Entropic and keeps calling Turing's name.

units.rawText: Turing! Turing, can you hear me?
units.displayText: Turing! Turing, can you hear me?

spans.text: Turing! Turing, can you hear me?

units.rawText: After cutting down several attacking Entropics and turning a corner, she can hear a familiar, faint voice coming from the depths of a corridor.
units.displayText: After cutting down several attacking Entropics and turning a corner, she can hear a familiar, faint voice coming from the depths of a corridor.

spans.text: After cutting down several attacking Entropics and turning a corner, she can hear a familiar, faint voice coming from the depths of a corridor.

units.rawText: ...Is that you, Miss Sol?
units.displayText: ...Is that you, Miss Sol?

spans.text: ...Is that you, Miss Sol?

units.rawText: Turing? Are you alright?
units.displayText: Turing? Are you alright?

spans.text: Turing? Are you alright?

units.rawText: Sol hurries into the room. Turing is hugging a storage container and curled up in a corner.
units.displayText: Sol hurries into the room. Turing is hugging a storage container and curled up in a corner.

spans.text: Sol hurries into the room. Turing is hugging a storage container and curled up in a corner.

units.rawText: I'm fine, my path was just blocked by the Entropics. They couldn't find me in there.
units.displayText: I'm fine, my path was just blocked by the Entropics. They couldn't find me in there.

spans.text: I'm fine, my path was just blocked by the Entropics. They couldn't find me in there.

units.rawText: I came to get you out of here. Do you still remember where the exit is?
units.displayText: I came to get you out of here. Do you still remember where the exit is?

spans.text: I came to get you out of here. Do you still remember where the exit is?

units.rawText: Yes, I know the quickest way out.
units.displayText: Yes, I know the quickest way out.

spans.text: Yes, I know the quickest way out.

units.rawText: Okay. From now on, you stand behind me and I'll clear us a path. Let's go!
units.displayText: Okay. From now on, you stand behind me and I'll clear us a path. Let's go!

spans.text: Okay. From now on, you stand behind me and I'll clear us a path. Let's go!

units.rawText: ...Yeah.
units.displayText: ...Yeah.

spans.text: ...Yeah.

units.rawText: Turing looks curiously at Sol before pointing to a direction.
units.displayText: Turing looks curiously at Sol before pointing to a direction.

spans.text: Turing looks curiously at Sol before pointing to a direction.

units.rawText: That way?
units.displayText: That way?

spans.text: That way?

units.rawText: Yeah. Go straight ahead, then turn left. There are three to five Entropics at the corner, so getting past will be hard.
units.displayText: Yeah. Go straight ahead, then turn left. There are three to five Entropics at the corner, so getting past will be hard.

spans.text: Yeah. Go straight ahead, then turn left. There are three to five Entropics at the corner, so getting past will be hard.

units.rawText: Leave it to me!
units.displayText: Leave it to me!

spans.text: Leave it to me!

units.rawText: Sol charges forward swinging her blades and cutting down all enemies in her way.
units.displayText: Sol charges forward swinging her blades and cutting down all enemies in her way.

spans.text: Sol charges forward swinging her blades and cutting down all enemies in her way.

units.rawText: Keep right at the next corner. Once you reach the corridor, the fourth door on the left leads to an emergency exit. We can escape to the first floor from there.
units.displayText: Keep right at the next corner. Once you reach the corridor, the fourth door on the left leads to an emergency exit. We can escape to the first floor from there.

spans.text: Keep right at the next corner. Once you reach the corridor, the fourth door on the left leads to an emergency exit. We can escape to the first floor from there.

units.rawText: But there's a chance it might be blocked by fallen rocks.
units.displayText: But there's a chance it might be blocked by fallen rocks.

spans.text: But there's a chance it might be blocked by fallen rocks.

units.rawText: Relax. Haven't you noticed that the sounds of gunfire have stopped?
units.displayText: Relax. Haven't you noticed that the sounds of gunfire have stopped?

spans.text: Relax. Haven't you noticed that the sounds of gunfire have stopped?

units.rawText: Hannah and Croque must have taken out the enemy artillery.
units.displayText: Hannah and Croque must have taken out the enemy artillery.

spans.text: Hannah and Croque must have taken out the enemy artillery.

units.rawText: Hannah...
units.displayText: Hannah...

spans.text: Hannah...

units.rawText: Relax, she's safe. I'll bring you to her right away!
units.displayText: Relax, she's safe. I'll bring you to her right away!

spans.text: Relax, she's safe. I'll bring you to her right away!

units.rawText: Chunks of debris litter the floor of the bombed-out Admin Center. Sol leads Turing in a nimble dash between the various obstacles and they soon lose the Entropics.
units.displayText: Chunks of debris litter the floor of the bombed-out Admin Center. Sol leads Turing in a nimble dash between the various obstacles and they soon lose the Entropics.

spans.text: Chunks of debris litter the floor of the bombed-out Admin Center. Sol leads Turing in a nimble dash between the various obstacles and they soon lose the Entropics.

units.rawText: However, the Entropics that she shook off do not continue the pursuit. Instead, they all raise their heads as one, then turn around and head the other way.
units.displayText: However, the Entropics that she shook off do not continue the pursuit. Instead, they all raise their heads as one, then turn around and head the other way.

spans.text: However, the Entropics that she shook off do not continue the pursuit. Instead, they all raise their heads as one, then turn around and head the other way.

units.rawText: They're giving up already? That's not right... Judging by how they're all moving as one, could someone else be directing them?
units.displayText: They're giving up already? That's not right... Judging by how they're all moving as one, could someone else be directing them?

spans.text: They're giving up already? That's not right... Judging by how they're all moving as one, could someone else be directing them?

units.rawText: Keep going down the stairs and you'll see the exit.
units.displayText: Keep going down the stairs and you'll see the exit.

spans.text: Keep going down the stairs and you'll see the exit.

units.rawText: Sweet. Let's not worry about that for now; getting out is more important.
units.displayText: Sweet. Let's not worry about that for now; getting out is more important.

spans.text: Sweet. Let's not worry about that for now; getting out is more important.

units.rawText: Sol escorts Turing to the first floor, but what greets them is a terrifying scene—
units.displayText: Sol escorts Turing to the first floor, but what greets them is a terrifying scene—

spans.text: Sol escorts Turing to the first floor, but what greets them is a terrifying scene—

units.rawText: A big pack of Entropics is bunched up in front of the exit and Liquid Entropy has soaked the entire corridor, turning the floor a deep purple.
units.displayText: A big pack of Entropics is bunched up in front of the exit and Liquid Entropy has soaked the entire corridor, turning the floor a deep purple.

spans.text: A big pack of Entropics is bunched up in front of the exit and Liquid Entropy has soaked the entire corridor, turning the floor a deep purple.

units.rawText: Why are there so many here...
units.displayText: Why are there so many here...

spans.text: Why are there so many here...

units.rawText: Turing, where's the nearest other exit?
units.displayText: Turing, where's the nearest other exit?

spans.text: Turing, where's the nearest other exit?

units.rawText: This way...
units.displayText: This way...

spans.text: This way...

units.rawText: ...No, it's full of Entropics too.
units.displayText: ...No, it's full of Entropics too.

spans.text: ...No, it's full of Entropics too.

units.rawText: Ugh... There's no way to get close...
units.displayText: Ugh... There's no way to get close...

spans.text: Ugh... There's no way to get close...

units.rawText: All the Entropics that were supposed to be scattered throughout the building are all clustered at the exits. Did they pull back just now to block all the ways out?
units.displayText: All the Entropics that were supposed to be scattered throughout the building are all clustered at the exits. Did they pull back just now to block all the ways out?

spans.text: All the Entropics that were supposed to be scattered throughout the building are all clustered at the exits. Did they pull back just now to block all the ways out?

units.rawText: Someone IS directing them, but who could it be? Odile? She ought to be over on the Prof's side, right?
units.displayText: Someone IS directing them, but who could it be? Odile? She ought to be over on the Prof's side, right?

spans.text: Someone IS directing them, but who could it be? Odile? She ought to be over on the Prof's side, right?

units.rawText: As Sol thinks, she steadily evades the encroaching Entropics.
units.displayText: As Sol thinks, she steadily evades the encroaching Entropics.

spans.text: As Sol thinks, she steadily evades the encroaching Entropics.

units.rawText: Sol...
units.displayText: Sol...

spans.text: Sol...

units.rawText: It's okay, I'm here. Since we can't fight our way out, we'll just have to wait for Croque and the others to come get us.
units.displayText: It's okay, I'm here. Since we can't fight our way out, we'll just have to wait for Croque and the others to come get us.

spans.text: It's okay, I'm here. Since we can't fight our way out, we'll just have to wait for Croque and the others to come get us.

units.rawText: Is there a room around here that has sturdy doors and at least two exits?
units.displayText: Is there a room around here that has sturdy doors and at least two exits?

spans.text: Is there a room around here that has sturdy doors and at least two exits?

units.rawText: There is, that way.
units.displayText: There is, that way.

spans.text: There is, that way.

units.rawText: Let's go. Lead the way.
units.displayText: Let's go. Lead the way.

spans.text: Let's go. Lead the way.

units.rawText: In a cluster of buildings not far from the Admin Center.
units.displayText: In a cluster of buildings not far from the Admin Center.

spans.text: In a cluster of buildings not far from the Admin Center.

units.rawText: So the Entropics bombarding the Admin Center are nearby?
units.displayText: So the Entropics bombarding the Admin Center are nearby?

spans.text: So the Entropics bombarding the Admin Center are nearby?

units.rawText: Yeah. Be careful... These Entropics have been avoiding close combat with us, while extra big Entropics are shielding them. In addition, there are also Entropics ambushing us from the shadows...
units.displayText: Yeah. Be careful... These Entropics have been avoiding close combat with us, while extra big Entropics are shielding them. In addition, there are also Entropics ambushing us from the shadows...

spans.text: Yeah. Be careful... These Entropics have been avoiding close combat with us, while extra big Entropics are shielding them. In addition, there are also Entropics ambushing us from the shadows...

units.rawText: Those would be Filthbelchers and Acedias. We met those on the way here, and then there are those Gloomlurkers... Don't worry, my Aegis will draw all their fire.
units.displayText: Those would be Filthbelchers and Acedias. We met those on the way here, and then there are those Gloomlurkers... Don't worry, my Aegis will draw all their fire.

spans.text: Those would be Filthbelchers and Acedias. We met those on the way here, and then there are those Gloomlurkers... Don't worry, my Aegis will draw all their fire.

units.rawText: It seems I don't have enough ex—Target sighted! Croque!
units.displayText: It seems I don't have enough ex—Target sighted! Croque!

spans.text: It seems I don't have enough ex—Target sighted! Croque!

units.rawText: Hang on, Dirac needs some time to cool down!
units.displayText: Hang on, Dirac needs some time to cool down!

spans.text: Hang on, Dirac needs some time to cool down!

units.rawText: Leave it to me. Structural coordinate analysis complete... Begin dismantling program!
units.displayText: Leave it to me. Structural coordinate analysis complete... Begin dismantling program!

spans.text: Leave it to me. Structural coordinate analysis complete... Begin dismantling program!

units.rawText: As Hannah gives her command in a clear, crisp voice, the lowest floor of the building transforms into operands and vanishes. The sections covered in Liquid Entropy crash to the ground, and the Entropics climbing on them fall off as well.
units.displayText: As Hannah gives her command in a clear, crisp voice, the lowest floor of the building transforms into operands and vanishes. The sections covered in Liquid Entropy crash to the ground, and the Entropics climbing on them fall off as well.

spans.text: As Hannah gives her command in a clear, crisp voice, the lowest floor of the building transforms into operands and vanishes. The sections covered in Liquid Entropy crash to the ground, and the Entropics climbing on them fall off as well.

units.rawText: Right, this is it! Pulse—Bombardment!
units.displayText: Right, this is it! Pulse—Bombardment!

spans.text: Right, this is it! Pulse—Bombardment!

units.rawText: Dirac's light pierces through the building and accurately melts the Splashers above.
units.displayText: Dirac's light pierces through the building and accurately melts the Splashers above.

spans.text: Dirac's light pierces through the building and accurately melts the Splashers above.

units.rawText: Good, that takes care of the ones here.
units.displayText: Good, that takes care of the ones here.

spans.text: Good, that takes care of the ones here.

units.rawText: We've taken out the ones on the other side, Miss Croque!
units.displayText: We've taken out the ones on the other side, Miss Croque!

spans.text: We've taken out the ones on the other side, Miss Croque!

units.rawText: Hm? That was sooner than expected.
units.displayText: Hm? That was sooner than expected.

spans.text: Hm? That was sooner than expected.

units.rawText: It's all thanks to Miss Hannah helping us lock onto the targets so they couldn't get away.
units.displayText: It's all thanks to Miss Hannah helping us lock onto the targets so they couldn't get away.

spans.text: It's all thanks to Miss Hannah helping us lock onto the targets so they couldn't get away.

units.rawText: Well done, Hannah!
units.displayText: Well done, Hannah!

spans.text: Well done, Hannah!

units.rawText: Let's not bother with that pointless praise. Where are Turing and Sol? Did they send word?
units.displayText: Let's not bother with that pointless praise. Where are Turing and Sol? Did they send word?

spans.text: Let's not bother with that pointless praise. Where are Turing and Sol? Did they send word?

units.rawText: Wow, touchy, aren't you... I was just about to check in with them.
units.displayText: Wow, touchy, aren't you... I was just about to check in with them.

spans.text: Wow, touchy, aren't you... I was just about to check in with them.

units.rawText: Just as she finishes speaking, her communicator beeps an alert.
units.displayText: Just as she finishes speaking, her communicator beeps an alert.

spans.text: Just as she finishes speaking, her communicator beeps an alert.

units.rawText: Sol? We've taken care of all the Entropics here. How are things on your end? Is Turing alright?
units.displayText: Sol? We've taken care of all the Entropics here. How are things on your end? Is Turing alright?

spans.text: Sol? We've taken care of all the Entropics here. How are things on your end? Is Turing alright?

units.rawText: I found Turing and she's fine. We're safe for now.
units.displayText: I found Turing and she's fine. We're safe for now.

spans.text: I found Turing and she's fine. We're safe for now.

units.rawText: May I speak to Turing?
units.displayText: May I speak to Turing?

spans.text: May I speak to Turing?

units.rawText: I'm here, Hannah.
units.displayText: I'm here, Hannah.

spans.text: I'm here, Hannah.

units.rawText: Are you okay? Did the Entropy immunity program activate successfully? If you've been hurt or infected...
units.displayText: Are you okay? Did the Entropy immunity program activate successfully? If you've been hurt or infected...

spans.text: Are you okay? Did the Entropy immunity program activate successfully? If you've been hurt or infected...

units.rawText: I'm fine, Hannah. I'm hiding with Sol in the file room. The Entropics can't get in for now.
units.displayText: I'm fine, Hannah. I'm hiding with Sol in the file room. The Entropics can't get in for now.

spans.text: I'm fine, Hannah. I'm hiding with Sol in the file room. The Entropics can't get in for now.

units.rawText: Good... You need to take care of yourself, or else...
units.displayText: Good... You need to take care of yourself, or else...

spans.text: Good... You need to take care of yourself, or else...

units.rawText: Yeah...
units.displayText: Yeah...

spans.text: Yeah...

units.rawText: ...In any case, the Entropics have surrounded the Admin Center, and there are more of them than we saw before.
units.displayText: ...In any case, the Entropics have surrounded the Admin Center, and there are more of them than we saw before.

spans.text: ...In any case, the Entropics have surrounded the Admin Center, and there are more of them than we saw before.

units.rawText: These Entropics are using tactics. They first had their ranged units draw our attention, and then they sent all their forces to take out the Admin Center in one go.
units.displayText: These Entropics are using tactics. They first had their ranged units draw our attention, and then they sent all their forces to take out the Admin Center in one go.

spans.text: These Entropics are using tactics. They first had their ranged units draw our attention, and then they sent all their forces to take out the Admin Center in one go.

units.rawText: That's more intelligent than what we saw when we came... We need to send this info to the Professor.
units.displayText: That's more intelligent than what we saw when we came... We need to send this info to the Professor.

spans.text: That's more intelligent than what we saw when we came... We need to send this info to the Professor.

units.rawText: Can you sneak out the back door? It's just the two of you.
units.displayText: Can you sneak out the back door? It's just the two of you.

spans.text: Can you sneak out the back door? It's just the two of you.

units.rawText: There's a ton of Entropics at each exit. They've got the place locked up tight.
units.displayText: There's a ton of Entropics at each exit. They've got the place locked up tight.

spans.text: There's a ton of Entropics at each exit. They've got the place locked up tight.

units.rawText: I... I'll bring a team over to rescue you guys!
units.displayText: I... I'll bring a team over to rescue you guys!

spans.text: I... I'll bring a team over to rescue you guys!

units.rawText: Listen, Croque. There are a LOT of Entropics here!
units.displayText: Listen, Croque. There are a LOT of Entropics here!

spans.text: Listen, Croque. There are a LOT of Entropics here!

units.rawText: If there really is a leader in charge of them and they haven't revealed themselves, you might end up getting ambushed if you just come over!
units.displayText: If there really is a leader in charge of them and they haven't revealed themselves, you might end up getting ambushed if you just come over!

units.rawText: ...Sol, Turing, you're in the file room now, right?
units.displayText: ...Sol, Turing, you're in the file room now, right?

spans.text: ...Sol, Turing, you're in the file room now, right?

units.rawText: Yes. The doors here are sturdier than most, so we won't have to worry about the Entropics breaking in. However, this place is on the other end of the corridor from the exit, so a rescue will be tough.

units.displayText: Croque, please blast the file room open.

spans.text: Croque, please blast the file room open.

units.rawText: Hannah?!
units.displayText: Hannah?!

spans.text: Hannah?!

units.rawText: The doors should be able to hold out for a while, right? Then we'll blast down the wall. That way Turing and Sol should be able to escape from the breach before the Entropics bash the doors down.
units.displayText: The doors should be able to hold out for a while, right? Then we'll blast down the wall. That way Turing and Sol should be able to escape from the breach before the Entropics bash the doors down.

spans.text: The doors should be able to hold out for a while, right? Then we'll blast down the wall. That way Turing and Sol should be able to escape from the breach before the Entropics bash the doors down.

units.rawText: But if that happens, the Admin Center will completely collapse! There'll be no recovering the data inside...
units.displayText: But if that happens, the Admin Center will completely collapse! There'll be no recovering the data inside...

spans.text: But if that happens, the Admin Center will completely collapse! There'll be no recovering the data inside...

units.rawText: You should have enough time to escape before it collapses. And I don't care about the research data.
units.displayText: You should have enough time to escape before it collapses. And I don't care about the research data.

spans.text: You should have enough time to escape before it collapses. And I don't care about the research data.

units.rawText: You don't care... You mean...
units.displayText: You don't care... You mean...

spans.text: You don't care... You mean...

units.rawText: How about it? Can you do it, Croque?
units.displayText: How about it? Can you do it, Croque?

spans.text: How about it? Can you do it, Croque?

units.rawText: Hm... We won't be able to breach the wall if I don't use enough force, but if I use too much I might hurt them...
units.displayText: Hm... We won't be able to breach the wall if I don't use enough force, but if I use too much I might hurt them...

spans.text: Hm... We won't be able to breach the wall if I don't use enough force, but if I use too much I might hurt them...

units.rawText: I remember the position of the file room. The walls there should be quite fragile after a round of Entropic bombardment. Your secondary guns should be enough to break through.

units.rawText: ...That's doable...
units.displayText: ...That's doable...

spans.text: ...That's doable...

units.rawText: Sol, do as I say. Hide behind a filing cabinet with Turing. Croque and I will open fire.
units.displayText: Sol, do as I say. Hide behind a filing cabinet with Turing. Croque and I will open fire.

spans.text: Sol, do as I say. Hide behind a filing cabinet with Turing. Croque and I will open fire.

units.rawText: Trust me, okay? My plan is foolproof.
units.displayText: Trust me, okay? My plan is foolproof.

spans.text: Trust me, okay? My plan is foolproof.

units.rawText: Sol is about to say something when memories come back to her.
units.displayText: Sol is about to say something when memories come back to her.

spans.text: Sol is about to say something when memories come back to her.

units.rawText: How can you smile at a time like this?! Don't you know you're going to die?
units.displayText: How can you smile at a time like this?! Don't you know you're going to die?

spans.text: How can you smile at a time like this?! Don't you know you're going to die?

units.rawText: Why didn't you let me go on with it? It was the best plan that I could come up with!
units.displayText: Why didn't you let me go on with it? It was the best plan that I could come up with!

spans.text: Why didn't you let me go on with it? It was the best plan that I could come up with!

units.rawText: The little girl shouting with all her might overlaps with the image of the calm girl in the communicator, and it leaves Sol a little dazed.
units.displayText: The little girl shouting with all her might overlaps with the image of the calm girl in the communicator, and it leaves Sol a little dazed.

spans.text: The little girl shouting with all her might overlaps with the image of the calm girl in the communicator, and it leaves Sol a little dazed.

units.displayText: They sure grow up fast...

spans.text: They sure grow up fast...

units.rawText: ...Alright. Do as she says, Croque.
units.displayText: ...Alright. Do as she says, Croque.

spans.text: ...Alright. Do as she says, Croque.

units.rawText: Good grief. Don't dump the responsibility for all this important stuff onto me...
units.displayText: Good grief. Don't dump the responsibility for all this important stuff onto me...

spans.text: Good grief. Don't dump the responsibility for all this important stuff onto me...

units.rawText: Hannah and I will share the responsibility then, haha.

units.displayText: Yes.
